newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare, FHP get request for more information.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare, FHP get request for more information.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc and FHP International Corp said Friday that each has received a request for additional information from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission with respect to their previously annouced merger.
Both companies said they intend to respond promptly to the requests.
The proposed transaction is planned to close in early January 1997.
In August, PacifiCare signed a definitive agreement to acquire FHP in a deal valued at about $2.1 billion.
The merger would create a company with more than $8.6 billion in revenues and almost four million members.
